name: ADR and Project Documentation Standards
description: Standards for architecture documents, plans, and ADRs
applyTo: "**/*.md"

# Documentation standards
- Write in a concise, decision-oriented style.
- State business context, technical context, assumptions, and constraints.
- For architecture decisions, always include alternatives considered and trade-offs.
- For plans, include owner, dependencies, milestones, risks, and validation criteria.
- For estimation artifacts, separate facts, assumptions, and uncertainty.
